note: Navigation and evidence index. Values are author-reported, not replicated here.

claims.statement: At test time both proposer and solver parameters remain fixed; adaptation revises executable harness code.
Mean single-step score on 21 selected unseen Reasoning Gym families increases from about 0.32 for Base to 0.62 after SFT + Single-step RL.
claims.population: 21 selected unseen families; eight attempted proposals per family; format-varied questions
qualifications: Five difficult unseen families omitted from this headline subset.
Not all unseen families or a general model-capability comparison.
Failed proposals count in means; consult B.1 for retained-parent treatment.

claims.statement: Across all 26 unseen Reasoning Gym families, the reported means are Base 0.282, SFT 0.415, Single-step RL 0.528, and teacher 0.501.
On the selected 21-family comparison, RL exceeds teacher in mean score but teacher exceeds RL under held-out oracle best-of-eight.
qualifications: Oracle selection uses held-out scores and is not a deployable adaptation rule.

claims.statement: MuSiQue Single-step RL independent revisions average 0.1467 EM; ten-round adaptation reaches about 0.27 EM.
claims.population: 299 MuSiQue held-out questions; independent pool of 80 proposals and four sequential runs of 80 proposals each
qualifications: Ten-round figure value rounded in main text.
Proposal count matches per sequential run, not four-run total.
Feedback and compute unmatched; seed evaluated separately by protocol.

claims.statement: Multistep RL does not consistently improve on Single-step RL; both can adapt repeatedly at inference.
Reasoning Gym keeps only strictly improving development candidates; QA advances to best runnable candidate even below parent, keeping parent if all candidates fail.
Correct computational helpers can fail to contribute because parsing, tool communication, or answer extraction fails.
qualifications: Qualitative inspected examples, not proof of a universal causal mechanism.
